supersession_reason: The v1 all-node simultaneous swap was not a valid accuracy positive control because post-LN residual identity paths remain and repeated exchanges can cancel. The target cohort stayed outcome-unseen. V2 uses an exact terminal CLS residual swap, which must exchange the classifier input representation.

scope.question: Which individual CLS attention-head contexts and MLP writes are most important for correct promoter versus pseudo-TSS classification?
scope.intervention: reciprocal paired exchange of one target/control CLS node
scope.boundary: The atlas identifies class-specific CLS write nodes under paired activation exchange. It does not establish a source motif, a complete circuit, zero-ablation behavior, or biological promoter function.

node_universe.head_hook: attention context before shared output projection
node_universe.mlp_hook: MLP output projection before residual addition

inference.multiplicity: one-sided maximum sign-flip correction across all 156 nodes
inference.confirmation_policy: score the complete 156-node family unchanged; report development-selected candidates and full-family replicated gates
